# Serving stack: the vLLM host that answers the benchmark's requests.
#
# This host runs nothing else. It does not import the tool layer, the scorer or
# the analysis code, so it does not share their numpy pin: vLLM and torch bring
# their own, and forcing numpy==1.26.4 on them (as the single requirements.txt
# used to) is the conflict that made a co-author's rerun impossible to install
# (R1-R4).
#
#     python -m venv .venv-serving && . .venv-serving/bin/activate
#     pip install -r _experiments/env/requirements-serving.txt
#
# CUDA 12.x must be on the host and CUDA_HOME must point at it: the Qwen3.5/3.6
# and MoE configurations compile a flashinfer kernel at start-up and die
# immediately when it points elsewhere.

vllm==0.20.1
transformers==5.7.0
torch==2.11.0
tokenizers==0.22.2

# `tokenizers==0.23.1` and `huggingface-hub==1.6.2` were written from a resolved
# environment that no longer installs: 1.6.2 is not on PyPI, and 0.23.1 conflicts
# with transformers 5.7.0. 0.22.2 is what the three pins above resolve to, and it
# is pinned here so every host in the cohort lands on the same one.

# The Kanana tool parser is loaded as a vLLM plugin from this repository
# (_experiments/scripts/kanana_tool_calls); it needs no package.
